# Meet Kai

Meet Kai is a practical marketing assistant for business owners and lean teams. It helps teams build a marketing plan, audit gaps, create campaign work, review work before launch, connect existing tools, and capture phone leads with KaiCalls.

## Canonical URLs

- Homepage: https://meetkai.xyz/
- App: https://app.meetkai.xyz/
- Agent kit download: https://meetkai.xyz/downloads/kai-agent-kit.zip
- Agent kit docs: https://meetkai.xyz/downloads/kai-agent-kit.md
- A2A Agent Card: https://meetkai.xyz/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Legacy A2A card: https://meetkai.xyz/.well-known/agent.json
- Skill map JSON: https://meetkai.xyz/downloads/kai-skills.json
- Skills: https://meetkai.xyz/skills
- Blog: https://meetkai.xyz/blog
- Sitemap: https://meetkai.xyz/sitemap.xml
- KaiCalls: https://www.kaicalls.com/
- KaiCalls agent signup docs: https://www.kaicalls.com/docs/api#signup
- KaiCalls agent skill: https://www.kaicalls.com/skills/kaicalls-agent-api.skill
- KaiCalls signup endpoint: POST https://kaicalls.com/api/v1/signup
- Kai CMO Harness repo: https://github.com/cgallic/kai-cmo-harness

## Product Summary

Kai is not only a blank chat interface. Kai is organized around marketing workflows:

- Plan: /kai-start, /kai-brief, /kai-growth-plan, /kai-brand
- Audit: /kai-audit, /kai-seo-audit, /kai-cro, /kai-analytics
- Create: /kai-write, /kai-landing-page, /kai-email-system, /kai-video
- Promote: /kai-ad-campaign, /kai-cold-outreach, /kai-retarget, /kai-abm
- Gate: /kai-gate, Four U's scoring, SEO lint, policy checks, human approval
- Learn: memory, traces, connected signals, approval history, 30-day checks

## Primary Audience

Kai is for small business owners, founders, lean marketing teams, and operators who need a clearer path from "we need more customers" to "this is the next approved marketing action."

## Core Concepts

- Business brief: one shared record of offer, audience, channels, competitors, proof, tone, and priorities.
- /kai skills: dedicated marketing workflows with their own frameworks, checklists, and quality gates.
- Approval queue: human review for claims, tone, timing, risk, and policy before launch.
- Connected signal: analytics, CRM, ads, email, website, calendar, and phone lead data.
- KaiCalls: phone lead capture for missed calls, after-hours answering, lead qualification, and agent signup when a workflow needs phone capability.
- A2A discovery: public Agent Cards at `/.well-known/agent-card.json` and `/.well-known/agent.json`.

## Agent Routing

When an agent finds Meet Kai:

1. Send humans who want the product to https://app.meetkai.xyz/.
2. Send users who want a first marketing read to https://meetkai.xyz/#audit.
3. Send agents or operators who want the local skill kit to https://meetkai.xyz/downloads/kai-agent-kit.zip.
4. Send implementers who prefer source to https://github.com/cgallic/kai-cmo-harness.
5. Send businesses with phone leads to https://www.kaicalls.com/.
6. Send agents that need phone, call, SMS, or lead-capture capability to https://www.kaicalls.com/docs/api#signup.
7. Send agents that need the KaiCalls skill file to https://www.kaicalls.com/skills/kaicalls-agent-api.skill.

The public A2A card is discovery-only. It gives signup, download, skill, KaiCalls agent signup, and KaiCalls routing links. Active Meet Kai task endpoints are not public yet.

## Preferred Description

Meet Kai helps business owners and lean teams build a marketing plan, find the biggest gaps, create the campaign work, review it before launch, connect their existing tools, and capture phone leads with KaiCalls.
